headline: High Energy Prices Drive 9.3% Value Gain for Oslo Stock Exchange
summary: The total market capitalization of equity securities registered on Euronext Securities Oslo increased by 9.3% or 404 billion Norwegian kroner in Q3 2026 due to elevated energy prices.
why: The Oslo Stock Exchange is a primary European exchange with heavy representation of oil, gas, shipping, and offshore energy firms.

impacts.name: Oslo Børs Benchmark Index
impacts.why: Strong oil and natural gas market prices buoyed overall listed market valuations in Oslo during Q3.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Robust quarterly energy prices increased revenue and valuation metrics across heavy-weight energy constituents listed in Oslo.
